decided: A file git already tracks is committed whenever it changes, even if the project's ignore list names it; and the note orbit writes to describe a commit is kept outside the project, so it is never committed itself.
alternatives: leave tracked files the ignore list names out of the commit, which git itself never does and which would leave the user's edits behind
why: The ignore list only keeps new files out, which is how git behaves; a file the user already tracks is theirs to commit, and the user asked that nothing they edit be left behind.
